mark_scheme.criterion: States rate of change of displacement. Accept change of displacement per unit time.

hints: Velocity must use a directional motion quantity rather than distance.
State what changes and how that change is compared with time.
solution: Velocity is the rate of change of displacement.
teacher_walkthrough: Velocity describes how displacement changes as time passes.
Displacement is used rather than distance because velocity includes direction.
The exact definition is: velocity is the rate of change of displacement.
